title: Patients Tab
description: Patients Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers patients tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Read the patient summary cards
subtasks.purpose: Get a same-page overview of enrolment, activity, quality and CPT-billing status.

steps.title: Read Total Patients
steps.description: Read Total Patient — the coloured chips split the total into A (Active), P (Pending), L (Lost / Inactive).

steps.title: Review Recent Uploads
steps.description: Read Recent Uploads and click “click to view all” to open the filtered patient list.

steps.title: Review Missed Uploads
steps.description: Read Missed Uploads to see how many patients need outreach.

steps.title: Review Abnormal Readings
steps.description: Read Abnormal Readings to see how many patients need clinical review.

steps.title: Review CPT Billing
steps.description: Read CPT Billing to see actual vs target readings for each billing code (99453, 99445, 99454, …). Notes The RPM billing date range (top-right) drives every CPT card total — verify the window before quoting numbers. Clicking any card’s link deep-links to the same Patients tab pre-filtered by that condition.

subtasks.title: Work the patient grid
subtasks.purpose: Search, filter, sort and act on individual patients.

steps.title: Search Patients by Name
steps.description: Use the Search patients by name… box to jump to a patient.

steps.title: Filter by Status
steps.description: Use the All Status dropdown to filter by A / P / L.

steps.title: Switch Program View
steps.description: Click the CCM or RPM chip (top-right of the grid) to switch program view.

steps.title: Add a Patient
steps.description: Click + Add Patient to enrol a new patient.

steps.title: Open Patient Dashboard
steps.description: Click a Name to open the patient dashboard, or use the eye / pencil / trash icons in Action. Notes Red numeric values (e.g. Diastolic 120.00) indicate the reading is outside the practice target range configured under Schedule & Targets. The heart icon beside a pulse or glucose value opens the reading trend for that vital. The 0 value shown in orange under Glucose indicates a zero/invalid reading that should be reviewed.
